details.s: Círdan, also known as Nowë and Círdan the Shipwright, was one of the highest and noblest of the Sindar, Lord of the Falathrim during the First Age, and Master of the Grey Havens through the Second, Third, and Fourth Age. He was one of the wisest and most clairvoyant of the Elves, and by the Second Age the oldest known elf in Middle-earth, to remain so throughout that age and into the Fourth Age as well. He was also gifted Narya, one of the Three Rings, by Celebrimbor until he surrendered it to Gandalf.
f: Lord of the Havens, Master of the Grey Havens, The Shipwright
Eventually sailed to Valinor after FO 120
